user.title: Home Keeper — IPP printer supplies
user.description: Turns low ink and toner levels of your IPP printers into Home Keeper tasks. One instance covers every printer; tune it in the options afterwards.

abort.already_configured: Already set up — one instance covers every IPP printer.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Already set up — one instance covers every IPP printer.

error.limits_too_high: Low limit plus refill margin must not exceed 100 %.

data.clear_on_refill: Clear the task when a new cartridge is reported

data_description.threshold: Each cartridge uses the low level its printer reports ('Marker low level'). This value applies when the printer reports none (0 or nothing).
data_description.recovery_margin: A new cartridge is recognised once the level is this many points above the cartridge's low limit (printer says 10 % + 20 = 30 %). Keeps a level wobbling near the limit from clearing and re-raising the task.
data_description.clear_on_refill: On: the printer clears the task, and a manual Done is undone while no new cartridge is reported. Off: you clear the task yourself.
data_description.name_template: Placeholders: {marker} (cartridge) and {printer}. Empty uses the default for your language. Applies to new tasks.
data_description.excluded_entities: Their tasks are removed. Useful for waste-toner boxes, drums or a fuser you do not want to track.
data_description.stock_enabled: One appliance per printer with each cartridge as a part. A replacement draws one spare; set a reorder point and turn on 'Auto-create buy task' on a part to get a buy task when you run low.
